scenes.visual: Title card: THE MAP OF ALLOWED SHAPES.

scenes.tts: Two hinges per residue sounds like a lot of freedom. How many of those settings actually work?
scenes.visual: Two linked flat cards with φ and ψ dials. The question appears as on-screen text.
scenes.narration: Two hinges per residue sounds like a lot of freedom. How many of those settings actually work?

scenes.tts: Take two linked cards. Hold one hinge still, and turn the other.
scenes.visual: One dial is held; the other turns slowly, swinging the second card around.
scenes.narration: Take two linked cards. Hold one hinge still, and turn the other.

scenes.tts: At many settings, an atom on one card runs into an atom on the next.
scenes.visual: As the card swings, two atoms come too close; they flash red.
scenes.narration: At many settings, an atom on one card runs into an atom on the next.

scenes.tts: A C O group comes too close to an N H group. Or a side chain runs into the backbone.
scenes.caption: A C=O group comes too close to an N–H group. Or a side chain runs into the backbone.
scenes.visual: Two red flashes in turn: a C=O pushed too close to an N–H; then a side-chain stub running into the backbone.
scenes.narration: A C=O group comes too close to an N–H group. Or a side chain runs into the backbone.

scenes.tts: The atoms would have to sit in the same space. Those settings are strongly disfavored.
scenes.visual: The overlapping atoms are shaded red. Label: steric clash.
scenes.narration: The atoms would have to sit in the same space. Those settings are strongly disfavored.

scenes.tts: Now try every pair of angles. Put fie along the bottom and sigh up the side.
scenes.caption: Now try every pair of angles. Put phi along the bottom and psi up the side.
scenes.visual: A square grid appears. Horizontal axis labelled φ, vertical axis labelled ψ.
scenes.narration: Now try every pair of angles. Put phi along the bottom and psi up the side.

scenes.tts: Each runs from minus one hundred eighty degrees to plus one hundred eighty degrees.
scenes.caption: Each runs from −180° to +180°.
scenes.visual: Axis ticks appear at −180°, 0° and +180° on both axes.
scenes.narration: Each runs from −180° to +180°.

scenes.tts: Shade every pair that does not clash. G. N. Ramachandran did this calculation.
scenes.visual: The grid fills in cell by cell: clashing cells stay empty, allowed cells turn colored. Name card: G. N. Ramachandran.
scenes.narration: Shade every pair that does not clash. G. N. Ramachandran did this calculation.

scenes.tts: The survivors cluster into a few compact islands. The rest of the map is empty.
scenes.visual: The filling finishes: three colored islands on a mostly blank square.
scenes.narration: The survivors cluster into a few compact islands. The rest of the map is empty.

scenes.tts: Only a small fraction of the map is open to the backbone. This is the Ramachandran plot.
scenes.visual: Title over the map: Ramachandran plot. The blank area is labelled disfavored.
scenes.narration: Only a small fraction of the map is open to the backbone. This is the Ramachandran plot.

scenes.tts: Here is the test. Put both angles at zero, right in the center. Will that pair survive?
scenes.visual: A dot moves to the center of the map, φ = 0°, ψ = 0°. On-screen question: allowed or not?
scenes.narration: Here is the test. Put both angles at zero, right in the center. Will that pair survive?

scenes.visual: The question stays on screen; a small countdown ring runs.

scenes.tts: No. The atoms of neighbouring peptide planes run into each other. The center of the map is empty.
scenes.visual: The two-card model at φ = 0°, ψ = 0° shows atoms overlapping in red. The dot on the map flashes red.
scenes.narration: No. The atoms of neighbouring peptide planes run into each other. The center of the map is empty.

scenes.tts: Now read the islands. The broad one at the upper left is for extended strands, like the beta sheet.
scenes.visual: The upper-left island glows and is labelled β, extended strands.
scenes.narration: Now read the islands. The broad one at the upper left is for extended strands, like the beta sheet.

scenes.tts: The compact one at the lower left is the right-handed alpha helix.
scenes.visual: The lower-left island glows and is labelled right-handed α helix, near φ ≈ −57°, ψ ≈ −47°.
scenes.narration: The compact one at the lower left is the right-handed alpha helix.

scenes.tts: A small island at the upper right is left-handed. It is used mostly by glycine.
scenes.visual: The small upper-right island glows, labelled left-handed, mostly glycine.
scenes.narration: A small island at the upper right is left-handed. It is used mostly by glycine.

scenes.tts: Glycine roams more widely than any other residue. Its side chain is a single hydrogen, so it bumps into less.
scenes.visual: A glycine dot wanders across a wider shaded area than the others. Label: side chain = H, no Cβ.
scenes.narration: Glycine roams more widely than any other residue. Its side chain is a single hydrogen, so it bumps into less.

scenes.tts: Each island matches a real shape. The helix island builds a coil. The strand island builds a stretched chain.
scenes.visual: Beside the map, a schematic ribbon coils for the helix island and straightens for the strand island.
scenes.narration: Each island matches a real shape. The helix island builds a coil. The strand island builds a stretched chain.

scenes.tts: The map is also a check on new structures. Plot every residue's two angles.
scenes.visual: Dozens of small dots scatter onto the map from a schematic structure model.
scenes.narration: The map is also a check on new structures. Plot every residue's two angles.

scenes.tts: If the points land on the islands, the structure is plausible. If many stray, something is probably wrong.
scenes.visual: Most dots sit on the islands with a green tick. In a second panel many dots lie in the blank area with an orange warning.
scenes.narration: If the points land on the islands, the structure is plausible. If many stray, something is probably wrong.

scenes.tts: Forbidden means strongly disfavored, not impossible. A few residues sit in strained spots, held by their surroundings.
scenes.visual: One lone dot sits outside the islands, ringed. Label: outlier.
scenes.narration: Forbidden means strongly disfavored, not impossible. A few residues sit in strained spots, held by their surroundings.

scenes.tts: Those outliers are often the ones that matter for catalysis.
scenes.visual: The ringed dot links by an arrow to a small active-site label.
scenes.narration: Those outliers are often the ones that matter for catalysis.

scenes.tts: Most hinge settings crash. The backbone is left with only a few local shapes.
scenes.visual: End card. LINE: Most phi and psi pairs clash, so the backbone is left with a few islands: helix, strand and a small left-handed region.
scenes.narration: Most hinge settings crash. The backbone is left with only a few local shapes.
